Class AmwpToon.ExecuteBody

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.wire.AmwpToon.ExecuteBody
Enclosing class:
AmwpToon
public static final class AmwpToon.ExecuteBody extends Object
The ExecuteBody class is one execute request. AmwpToon.encodeExecute(AmwpToon.ExecuteBody) writes it. AmwpToon.decodeExecute(byte[]) reads it. A boolean that stays false is left off the wire, except sendReasoningEffort.

  • Field Details

    • cellId

      public String cellId

    • executionTarget

      public String executionTarget

    • ephemeral

      public boolean ephemeral
      The flag marks an ephemeral cell. A false flag is left off the wire. A missing line means false.

    • toolCallingEnabled

      public boolean toolCallingEnabled
      The flag asks for tool calling. A false flag is left off the wire. A missing line means false. This type does not set the flag to true by itself.

    • burnerCloud

      public boolean burnerCloud
      The flag is the Grok burner hop. A burner is an ephemeral request that may use a cloud target. The flag is not notebook.burner-key. A false flag is left off the wire. A missing line means false.

    • thinkStream

      public boolean thinkStream
      The flag is the Grok stream setting. It is not the Ollama think setting. A false flag is left off the wire. A missing line means false.

    • reasoningEffort

      public String reasoningEffort
      The value is the Grok reasoning effort. An empty value stays off the wire. A missing line stays empty. The service maps an empty Grok value to high when the send flag is on.

    • sendReasoningEffort

      public boolean sendReasoningEffort
      The flag starts true, so a missing line means the effort is sent. A false flag writes send_reasoning_effort: false. That false leaves reasoning_effort off the Grok body.

    • think

      public String think
      The value is the Ollama think setting. An empty value means off and is left off the wire. A missing line stays empty. true is the checkbox. Any other value is the level. Off does not send false.

    • temperaturePresent

      public boolean temperaturePresent
      The flag is true when temperature should be written. A false flag leaves the cell factory temperature on the server.

    • temperature

      public double temperature

    • maxCompletionPresent

      public boolean maxCompletionPresent
      The flag is true when maxCompletionTokens should be written. A false flag leaves the cell factory cap on the server.

    • maxCompletionTokens

      public int maxCompletionTokens

    • poolBoot

      public String poolBoot
      The value is the desktop boot text for the pool tail. An empty value stays off the wire. A missing line stays empty. An empty value keeps a new pool session on every prompt.

    • workingSet

      public final List<AmwpToon.Turn> workingSet
